normalizations.why: Apercu Pro is a licensed face not served by this project: adopted as the token string with a neutral grotesque fallback
display lines are set solid (1.0) in the donor; ratio survives the responsive scale

modules.name: Full-bleed photo hero
modules.anatomy: full-bleed photograph; bottom-left stack: eyebrow (10px caps) + h1 56px white + short body + two light CTAs; optional inset thumbnail right

modules.name: Split grid banner
modules.anatomy: promo line row (18px left + right) over 3-up edge-to-edge image tiles, each with centered overlay title 26px white + underline Shop Now CTA

modules.name: Category tile rail
modules.anatomy: tab row (16px labels, divider) + arrow buttons right; row of image tiles separated by 1px gaps, caption 12px under each image

modules.name: Image hero with detail row
modules.anatomy: full-bleed image with 80px heading over it; below, split row: 20px lede + two black CTAs left, row of bordered category tiles right

modules.name: Centered statement band
modules.anatomy: light band (rgb 229,225,222); centered eyebrow + 80px heading + media + 13px centered body + two black CTAs

modules.name: Editorial stagger
modules.anatomy: alternating image + text blocks on the page band; each text block: eyebrow (10px caps) + h3 26px + 13px body + one black CTA

modules.name: Split feature
modules.anatomy: 50/50: full-height photograph left; right column centered: eyebrow + h2 56px + bordered icon-tile grid + 13px body + two black CTAs

modules.name: Product rail
modules.anatomy: eyebrow + h2 56px + tab row + arrows; white tiles with badge, image, 12px title, meta, price

modules.name: Photo banner
modules.anatomy: dark full-bleed photograph band, left: eyebrow + h2 56px white + two light CTAs; optional thumbnails right

modules.name: Social stories strip
modules.anatomy: centered eyebrow + h2 56px + 13px body; row of portrait media cards, the focused one with caption panel

modules.name: Value-props band
modules.anatomy: light band; 4 equal columns divided by 1px rules: icon + 10px caps label + 11px body + underlined text link

modules.name: Dark footer
modules.anatomy: dark photographic band; 4 link columns (10px caps heading + 11px links), newsletter field, social icons, 32px statement + text link, legal row

modules.name: Utility bar + nav
modules.anatomy: 30px utility bar (rgb 229,225,222; 11px links left/center/right) over 64px nav: wordmark left, 12px centered links, icon actions right

modules.name: Prose band
modules.anatomy: page band, left-aligned stack, full measure: heading + media + body/lists (M5 anatomy without the centred greige statement composition)

modules.name: Editorial row (untinted)
modules.anatomy: image beside heading/body/CTA on the page band

modules.name: Dark quote band
modules.anatomy: full-bleed dark band, no photograph: large light text (quotation + attribution)

modules.name: Value-props tiles (untinted)
modules.anatomy: label + body + link tiles on the page band

notesForReskin: Sentence/title case headings, never uppercase except 10px eyebrows (letter-spaced caps); square corners everywhere; black solid CTAs on light bands, light (rgb 242,240,239) CTAs on photographs; edge-to-edge tiles with 1px gaps; 16px page gutter; warm off-white page band alternating with rgb(229,225,222) bands; red rgb(191,0,19) reserved for sale/emphasis words.
motifs: full-bleed photography with text anchored bottom-left
tight negative letter-spacing on large Apercu headings (-6%)
edge-to-edge tile grids separated by hairline gaps
warm neutral bands (off-white / greige) with a single black footer

design.description: A warm-neutral luxury retail system: one grotesque family set large with tight tracking, full-bleed photography, square black CTAs.

typography.display: hero and section headlines, 56px solid, -6% tracking

narrative.northStar: Quiet luxury: photography leads, type whispers.
narrative.overview: Full-bleed images and warm neutral bands carry large, tightly-tracked headlines and small, precise body copy.
rules: one or two CTAs per band
dos: anchor hero text bottom-left over photography
donts: introduce saturated colors beyond Kay Red emphasis
